items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27

ctx.x: Talking about your uncles. Yeah, well, there was

one named Wilson, Wilson Dominick. He played in those days the cornet. And that's Uncle Nat his oldest brother. He was even older than my, no, I think my daddy was the oldest and he was next. But he was killed. A bunch of guys jumped on him after a job uptown. And that was the end of him. And I had another uncle that was a great volumist. And in those days there wasn't a cue for tuberculosis. and he passed away with that a real young man. Of course, I think my grandmother must have had about 10, 12, 14 children.…
